chapter: Baton Rouge big band and New York
title: The eight-piece jazz band drawn from the big band
summary: The jazz band had eight pieces who could switch instruments and play anything, such as High Society and Livery Stable Blues.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom

blocks.x: Well, how big a jazz band did you use?
Yeah, we could play anything. You see, I had enough readers and everything. That's a way you could switch around and play anything you wanted.
And you had, uh, uh, you could play ten roof blues or?
Oh yeah, play anything you want.
High Society, all those different numbers. Liberty Stable Blues, you ever play that?
